title: Zoning text change for Studio 54 theater rehabilitation bonus
summary: This resolution approves a change to the Zoning Resolution's Special Midtown District rules governing theater rehabilitation bonus floor area transfers. It supports an application by Roundabout Theatre Company tied to a related special permit allowing about 187,783 square feet of bonus floor area for substantially rehabilitating the landmarked Studio 54 theater at 254 West 54th Street in Manhattan. The Council held a public hearing on the matter on October 20, 2026.
